name: Citizens reported this project
verify: Open the project on transparency.dpwh.gov.ph and read the citizen reports and photos.

name: Marked completed, progress below 100%
verify: Compare the status and progress on the portal with the project's documents and photos.

name: Reported 100% done but still listed as on-going
verify: Usually a status update that has not been entered yet. Check the portal for a newer status.

name: Same description 3+ times in one office
verify: Check whether these are separate phases or sections of one road, or a project listed more than once.

name: One contractor holds half an office's yearly budget
verify: Check the contractor's SEC General Information Sheet, and whether the contracts were competitively bid.

name: No coordinates on a large project
verify: Ask DPWH for the project location through eFOI so it can be inspected.
